title: Ethereum’s quantum race takes a new turn as zkSync courts banks and Starknet weighs exit
summary: ZkSync announced Airbender Prime, a prover that Matter Labs says handled 99% of 7,200 consecutive Ethereum mainnet blocks in under 10 seconds each on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU.
